driverFormulas.rev: Net Operating Income = Gross Interest, Fee & Other Income − Interest, Fee & Other Expense
driverFormulas.cogs: Credit Impairment & Provisions = Credit Impairment (ECL) + Provisions + Other Impairment
driverFormulas.gp: Net Income after Credit Costs = Net Operating Income − Credit Impairment & Provisions
driverFormulas.gp-pct: Income after Credit Costs % = GP / Net Operating Income x 100
driverFormulas.opex-excl: Administrative Expenses = Front Office & Distribution + Technology & Digital + Operations, Control & G&A
driverFormulas.ebitda: Pre-Depreciation Operating Profit = GP − Administrative Expenses
driverFormulas.ebitda-pct: Pre-Depreciation Margin % = Pre-Depreciation Profit / Net Operating Income x 100
driverFormulas.ebit-pct: Operating Margin % = Operating Profit / Net Operating Income x 100
driverFormulas.nonop: Other Gains & Losses = Equity-Method Result + Disposals + Other
driverFormulas.ebt: Pre-Tax Profit = Operating Profit + Other Gains & Losses
driverFormulas.ni: Profit for the Year = Pre-Tax Profit − Tax
driverFormulas.ni-pct: Net Profit Margin % = Profit / Net Operating Income x 100
driverFormulas.bs-assets: Total Assets = Lending & Treasury Assets + Other Assets
driverFormulas.bs-ca: Lending, Liquidity & Treasury Assets = Cash + Loans + Securities + Other
driverFormulas.bs-inv: Securities & Treasury Portfolio = Amortised Cost + FVOCI + Trading & FVTPL
driverFormulas.bs-nca: Fixed, Intangible & Other Assets = Premises + Accum. Depreciation + Goodwill & Intangibles + Other
driverFormulas.bs-liab-eq: Total Liabilities & Equity = Deposits & Funding + Other Liabilities + Equity
driverFormulas.bs-cl: Deposits & Short-Term Funding = Deposits + Accruals + ST Funding + Due to Banks
driverFormulas.bs-ncl: Other Liabilities = Other Financial Liabilities + Deferred Tax + Provisions
driverFormulas.bs-equity: Net Equity = Capital & Premium + Reserves + OCI
driverFormulas.cfo: Cash Flow from Operating Activities = Profit + D&A + Balance Sheet Movements
driverFormulas.cfi: Cash Flow from Investing Activities = CapEx + Disposals + Acquisitions
driverFormulas.cff: Cash Flow from Financing Activities = Debt + Equity + Dividends
driverFormulas.cf-net: Net Change in Cash = CFO + CFI + CFF
driverFormulas.cf-end-cash: Ending Cash = Net Change + Beginning Cash
